No teaching moment

8,652 posts, no single next step

Someone who feels seen by a post has to find your link in bio and choose between a book, a course, groups, consultations and sessions on their own. Most people faced with that many choices pick none.

Fixes the missing teaching moment

One free class becomes the single front door in your bio. Every sign-up is an email you keep, and every attendee feels how you work before you ask for anything.

Fixes the missing qualifier

The replay page invites the people who want more to apply. You only talk to people who watched, stayed and told you what support they're looking for.

Puts your products to work

Writing Your Grief and your groups stop waiting in a link list and get offered at the exact moment people want a next step.

The 95%*

Not ready for private sessions yet

They join the free class, take Writing Your Grief from the thank-you page, and hear about your groups in the follow-up emails. They get real support at their own pace and pay you while they build trust.

The qualified 5%

Ready for one-to-one work

They watch to the end and apply on the replay page. The application filters for fit before your calendar, and three pre-call emails help them arrive ready.

Megan Devine Refuge in Grief

A free 60-minute class with Megan Devine

Making Room: how to live alongside grief when everyone keeps trying to fix it

A free live class from the author of It's OK That You're Not OK. Why so much of the usual grief advice falls flat, and gentler ways to be with what hurts.

03Days
00Hours
00Mins
00Secs

Live online · 60 minutes · Replay for 48 hours · [Date and time]

Sound familiar?

Grief isn't a problem to be solved. It's something to be carried.

  • You're living with a loss, or supporting someone who is, and the usual advice isn't helping.
  • People keep telling you to stay positive, or that everything happens for a reason.
  • You've started to wonder if you're grieving "wrong", or taking too long.
  • You're tired of hiding how you really are so other people feel comfortable.

Here's what you'll learn

Five things we'll cover in 60 minutes

01

Why the usual advice falls flat

Why "time heals" and "stay positive" so often leave people feeling more alone, not less.

02

Tending, not fixing

The shift from trying to fix pain to tending it, and why that changes what actually helps.

03

Writing as a way to stay with it

A short, private writing practice in the spirit of Writing Your Grief, to try during class.

04

Asking for what you need

Simple ways to tell the people around you what helps, and what doesn't.

05

Your next step

How Megan's groups and private sessions work, so you can choose the support that fits.

Questions

Before you save your seat

Who is this for?

People living with a loss, and people who want to support someone who is. It's taught by Megan Devine, psychotherapist and author of It's OK That You're Not OK.

What if I can't make it live?

There's a replay for 48 hours, so you can watch when it suits you.

Does it cost anything?

No. The class is free. Your seat includes the 60-minute live class, a writing prompt to use during class, live Q&A with Megan and the 48-hour replay.

What happens after I sign up?

Your confirmation email comes from Megan. Reply "YES" to it so the class link and the replay land where you'll see them, then add the class to your calendar.

Is this therapy?

No. This class is education, not therapy, diagnosis or treatment. Camera off is completely fine, and the writing practice stays private.

Educational content, not medical or mental health advice. This class is not therapy.

Static 3 · Contrast layout · Hook: fixing vs making room

Script 1 · Reel · 30 to 45 seconds

"Everything happens for a reason"

Hook
"If someone has ever told you 'everything happens for a reason' and you wanted to scream, stay with me for 30 seconds." (to camera, close framing)
Body
"Most of what we're taught about grief is about making it go away. But grief isn't a problem to be fixed. It's something to be carried, and it gets more bearable when people stop trying to fix it. That's the heart of my book, It's OK That You're Not OK." (slow, warm pacing)
CTA
"I'm teaching a free 60-minute class called Making Room. Tap Sign up to save your seat."
Script 2 · Reel · 30 seconds

"What to say instead"

Hook
"Here's what to say to a grieving friend instead of 'let me know if you need anything'." (text on screen: "Instead of...")
Body
"Try: 'I'm dropping off dinner on Thursday. You don't have to talk.' Specific. No pressure. No fixing. Most of us were never taught how to show up for grief, our own or anyone else's." (on-screen captions)
CTA
"In my free class, Making Room, I share more of what actually helps. Link below."
Script 3 · Reel · 45 seconds

"Where do I start?"

Hook
"People ask me where to start with my work. Here's my honest answer." (walking, natural light)
Body
"There's my book, Writing Your Grief, groups and private sessions. If you're new, don't pick yet. Come to my free class first. You'll get a feel for how I work, and which next step fits you."
CTA
"It's called Making Room, it's free, and there's a replay if you can't make it live. Tap Sign up."
